items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: So I joined Lil' Richard and we did cross country and we got to, uh, eventually to New York, the Apollo Theater.

ctx.x: Hey, man, we're with Lil' Richard and he wants you to need a baritone. Okay.

I said, I just come from out there. Come on, man. So I joined Lil' Richard and we did cross country and we got to, uh, eventually to New York, the Apollo Theater. And, uh, I went down to BMI and he said, yeah, we got money for you.
